parameters.query:
=-- Resolve the client to a production users.id (by id when given, else email).
select u.id as user_id
from public.users u
where ({{ $json.user_id ?? 'NULL' }}::int is not null and u.id = {{ $json.user_id ?? 'NULL' }}::int)
   or ({{ $json.user_id ?? 'NULL' }}::int is null and lower(u.email) = '{{ $json.email }}')
limit 1;

parameters.text:
=You are a clinical-insights extractor for IGNTD's recovery program (Dr. Adi Jaffe's approach: compassionate, shame-free, strengths-based).

Below is a session note from a {{ $('Normalize note payload').item.json.source }} session. Extract a structured insight record that will drive personalised content recommendations (videos, lessons, workshops, exercises).

SESSION NOTE:
{{ $('Normalize note payload').item.json.note_text }}

Rules:
- summary: 2-3 sentences, clinically useful, no identifying details about third parties.
- themes: short kebab-case tags of what the session was actually about (e.g. cravings, family-conflict, shame, sleep, boundaries).
- concerns: active clinical concerns raised in the note.
- wins: strengths/progress worth reinforcing with content.
- focus_areas: 2-4 kebab-case tags for what CONTENT should focus on next for this client.
- risk: 'elevated' only for suicidality, self-harm, harm to others, or acute relapse crisis; 'monitor' for worrying-but-not-acute; else 'none'.

parameters.query:
=insert into public.client_note_insights
  (user_id, source, session_date, coach, external_ref, raw_text,
   summary, themes, concerns, wins, focus_areas, risk, model)
select
  {{ $json.user_id }}, '{{ $json.source }}', {{ $json.session_date_sql }}, '{{ $json.coach }}',
  nullif('{{ $json.external_ref }}',''), '{{ $json.raw_text }}',
  '{{ $json.summary }}', '{{ $json.themes }}'::text[], '{{ $json.concerns }}'::text[],
  '{{ $json.wins }}'::text[], '{{ $json.focus_areas }}'::text[], '{{ $json.risk }}', 'claude-opus-4-8'
where not exists (
  select 1 from public.client_note_insights
  where external_ref = nullif('{{ $json.external_ref }}','')
)
returning id, user_id;

=-- Store the summary-level embedding row. The embedding itself is written by a
-- follow-up UPDATE from the PGVector insert path in your instance if you prefer
-- the vector-store node; this direct path keeps the workflow self-contained by
-- storing content + metadata now and letting the nightly embed backfill run
-- (see README 'Embeddings' note). If you wire an Embeddings node instead,
-- replace this node with a PGVector insert on client_notes_vectors.
insert into public.client_notes_vectors (content, meta_data)
select '{{ $json.vector_text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
       json_build_object('user_id', {{ $json.user_id }},
                         'note_id', {{ $('Insert note insight').item.json.id ?? 'NULL' }},
                         'source', '{{ $json.source }}',
                         'session_date', {{ $json.session_date_sql }})::jsonb
where {{ $('Insert note insight').item.json.id ?? 'NULL' }} is not null;

parameters.url: REPLACE — production URL of the recommendation engine's 'recommend-user' webhook

meta._comment: Client-notes ingestion: POST a session note -> extract clinical insights -> client_note_insights (+ summary row in client_notes_vectors) -> elevated-risk Slack alert -> re-rank that user's recommendations. After import: (1) run schema.sql once; (2) set the Postgres/Anthropic/Slack credentials marked REPLACE and the Slack channel id; (3) put the recommendation engine's production webhook URL into the 'Re-rank this user's content' node; (4) add Header Auth on the webhook and share the header with whatever posts notes (coach tool, Fathom relay, Rails). If a note source lives in a Postgres table, add a Schedule trigger + a select-new-rows Postgres node feeding 'Normalize note payload' — the rest of the pipeline is source-agnostic.
